newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse listings rise to 47.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse listings rise to 47.

text.p: The Bucharest stock exchange said on Friday the number of its listings would rise to 47 next week when Amylon starch maker joins the second tier.
A bourse statement said the company, based in Sibiu in the central region of Transylvania, would begin trading on Monday.

It has a capital of 3.76 billion lei in shares with a nominal value of 1,000 lei each. Employees have a 50.95 percent stake in Amylon, the State Ownership Fund holds 9.08 percent and other shareholders have the rest.

The statement said Amylon had a net profit of 512 million lei last year, up from 264 million in 1995. The company has a programme for upgrading and restructuring until 2005 on 17.8 billion lei investment.
The Bucharest bourse currently trades eight stocks on the first tier and 38 in the lower section. ($=7,118 lei)
